title: Per-repeat NVML covariate sidecar
description: Closed-object replay schema for retained pre-S4 per-repeat NVML covariate sidecars emitted by the now-retired polling thread in `workloads/simbench_bw/cupti_activity_collector.{cu,h}`. Those frozen records contain the (timestamp_ns, power_mw, temp_c, throttle_reasons, sm_clock_mhz, mem_clock_mhz) time series and a typed `nvml_collector_status`. Historical CUPTI/NVML joins used the natural key `(slug, shape_point, repeat_index, binary_sha256, preflight_manifest_sha256)` and a shared host-monotonic clock domain. Active tooling may validate and replay those records but does not build or invoke the retired collector, request `SIMBENCH_NVML_OUTPUT_PATH`, emit this sidecar, or require a live CUPTI counterpart.

schema_version.description: Sidecar schema version. Bumped only when fields are added, removed, or change semantics.

slug.description: SimBench-BW kernel slug. In retained historical evidence it matches the frozen CUPTI record validated by historical/cupti_activity_sidecar.v1.schema.json.

shape_point.description: Shape-point identifier. In retained historical evidence it must equal `shape_point` in the frozen CUPTI record validated by historical/cupti_activity_sidecar.v1.schema.json.

repeat_index.description: Zero-based index of this repeat within the (slug, shape_point) cell. Historical replay requires equality with the frozen CUPTI sidecar's repeat_index.

binary_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the kernel runner binary the timing run used.

preflight_manifest_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the preflight manifest to which the historical run was anchored. Historical replay requires the same value in the frozen CUPTI sidecar.

claim_scope.description: Cross-die claim-scope label recorded by the retired producer and retained for historical replay.

polling_interval_ns.description: Polling interval targeted by the retired collector, nanoseconds. The historical contract required >=100 Hz, i.e. interval <= 10000000 ns. Retained for replay provenance; actual historical spacing remains observable in `samples[].timestamp_ns`.

host_monotonic_clock_source.description: Source of the per-sample timestamp clock recorded by the retired producer. Historical CUPTI Activity records used the same source through `cuptiActivityRegisterTimestampCallback`; replay uses this field as a provenance pin and refuses mismatched historical clock domains. Active tooling does not register the callback or emit this sidecar.

samples.description: Time-ordered NVML samples recorded during the historical repeat. Empty array is admissible only when `nvml_collector_status` is `nvml_covariate_unavailable`; replay interprets an empty array under any other status as an unaligned-window failure.

missing_capability_field.description: For a retained record with `nvml_collector_status == nvml_covariate_unavailable`, names the NVML capability field denied to the historical producer (for example `power_mw` or `sm_clock_mhz`). Replay requires the named field rather than treating an empty sidecar as admissible data.

alignment_gap_windows_ns.description: For a retained record with `nvml_collector_status == nvml_alignment_gap`, lists the historical per-launch CUPTI Activity (start_ns, end_ns) windows that contained zero NVML samples. Replay surfaces the typed `nvml_alignment_gap` diagnostic.

regression_residual_variance_reduction_p.description: Percent reduction in |gap_ns| residual variance recorded by the historical join's covariate regression versus uncorrected `T_wall`. Replay surfaces values below the retained >=10% threshold as `nvml_collector_status: nvml_covariate_regression_ineffective`.

regression_threshold_pct.description: Per-host residual-variance reduction threshold historically registered in `nvml_covariate_acceptance.toml`, percent. Retained so reviewer-package replay can re-evaluate the recorded admission decision.

timestamp_ns.description: Host-monotonic timestamp from the clock source named in the parent's `host_monotonic_clock_source`, nanoseconds. Field name matches the closure plan's verbatim per-sample contract spelling.

throttle_reasons.description: NVML clocks-throttle-reasons bitmask (NVML `nvmlDeviceGetCurrentClocksThrottleReasons`). 0 means no active throttling reason.

launch_index.description: Zero-based historical launch index whose frozen CUPTI Activity (start_ns, end_ns) window contains no NVML samples.

start_ns.description: Per-launch CUPTI Activity start timestamp retained from historical evidence, nanoseconds.

end_ns.description: Per-launch CUPTI Activity end timestamp retained from historical evidence, nanoseconds. Must satisfy end_ns >= start_ns.

nvml_collector_status_enum.description: Frozen historical per-repeat collector status. `ok` denotes recorded covariates that met the polling, alignment, and regression-effectiveness contract. `nvml_covariate_unavailable` names a denied historical capability via `missing_capability_field`; `nvml_alignment_gap` records frozen CUPTI Activity windows with no NVML sample; and `nvml_covariate_regression_ineffective` records a fit below the retained threshold. Replay preserves these enum names and surfaces them verbatim; active tooling does not run an NVML collector.
